Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

Indian Standard ( Reaffirmed 2002 ) 

DIMENSIONS OF SPINDLES AND MOUNTING 

ARRANGEMENTS FOR SPINDLE OPERATED 

ELECTRONIC COMPONENTS 

PART 1 SPINDLE 
Section 2 Plain Round Spindle 

( Second Revision ) 



0. General — The standard ( Part 1/Sec 2) shall be read in conjunction with IS : 4586 ( Part 1/Sec 1 ) 
1987 'Dimensions of spindles and mounting arrangements for spindle operated electronic components: 
Part 1 Spindles, Section 1 General and definitions {second revision )'. 

1. Scope — Covers dimensions of plain round spindles. 

2. Dimensions — See Table 1 . 



Adopted 6 May 1987

Note 1 — If intermediate values are required, they should preferably be chosen from the R 20 series (mm) 
[ ( see IS : 1076-1967 'Preferred numbers ( first revision )' ]. 
Note 2 — The tolerance on the length may be ±2 mm for potentiometers with high rated dissipation. 
Note 3 — Chamfer at 40750° or a radius for a depth of between 5 percent and 10 percent of dimension A. 
Note 4 — The underlined dimensions are preferred diameters. 

Note 5 — Values for dimensions B are chosen from R 20 series (mm) [(see IS : 1076-1967 'Preferred numbers' 
(first revision )']. 

Note 6 — Fixing of bush may be done by pressing a 'C washer in the groove cut in the spindle to a depth of 1 
to V5 mm. 

Note 7 — Dimensions apply to spindles after suitable finish. 



*IS:919 (Part 1 )-1963 'Recommendations for limits and fits for engineering; Part 1 General engineering 
(first revision )'.
